title: Gemma Model Registry
description: Static registry of LLM model artifacts. The app reads this to decide which model to download per device tier, OS, and available CDN.

paramCount.description: Number of parameters in millions (e.g., 2 for 2B, 4 for 4B, 9 for 9B).

quant.description: Quantization level. Lower bits = smaller file, lower quality.

format.description: Model file format. GGUF is cross-platform; MLX is Apple Silicon only.

sizeBytes.description: File size in bytes of the model artifact.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum for integrity verification after download.

cdnUrls.description: One or more CDN mirror URLs for the model artifact.

minDeviceTier.description: Minimum device RAM tier required: low (<=4GB), mid (6-8GB), high (>=12GB).

iosOnly.description: If true, this artifact is only available on iOS (e.g., MLX format).

androidOnly.description: If true, this artifact is only available on Android.

recommended.description: Marks the default model for this device tier.

notes.description: Optional human-readable notes (e.g., 'best quality/size tradeoff for mid-tier').
